newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-DAY 11 SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-DAY 11 SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.

text.p: A brief selection of highlights from the 11th day of the French Open on Thursday:
Best quote - "It's like comparing night and day." Monica Seles, asked to rate the styles of Martina Hingis and former world number one Steffi Graf.
Stat of the day - 35. The total ages of teenage women's finalists Martina Hingis and Iva Majoli, just 16 and 19 respectively.
Net interest - The French Open site on the Internet has attracted 24 million 'hits' since the tournament began.
